subject: math
description: Find unknown angles of an oblique triangle when all three side lengths are known, and check that the resulting angles are reasonable.
learningObjectives: Identify when the Law of Cosines can be used to find an angle
Choose the correct angle formula from three known side lengths
Calculate an unknown angle using inverse cosine
Check that the largest side is opposite the largest angle
Verify that the three triangle angles add to about 180°
prerequisites: Cosine and inverse cosine on a calculator
Law of Cosines for finding a side
